fields.description: Issue features extensive local political coverage ahead of the May 7, 1935 primary election for Miami city commission, including election odds and commentary on candidates. Editorials criticize a proposed Florida sales tax associated with Mayor Sewell and discuss efforts in Tallahassee to defeat the measure. Additional reporting alleges chain grocery stores understate inventory values to obtain lower city license fees. The issue also includes commentary on boxing regulation and a proposed state boxing commissioner, crime coverage involving a major hotel robbery and federal investigation, and reprinted/related discussion of dog racing as a corrupt racket. Includes campus/social columns and substantial local advertising.
